sources.claim: Unicode 17.0 names contain no semantic entries for the initial filter-response set.
sources.reuse_note: Reference only; no Unicode glyph artwork is imported.

sources.claim: Ableton Live 8.1 documents compact EQ Eight response selectors including low cut, low shelf, bell, notch, high shelf, and high cut.
sources.reuse_note: Evidence only; product artwork is not copied or traced.

sources.claim: Audio education material defines and illustrates low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and band-stop filtering as frequency-response concepts.
IEC 60617 standardizes related circuit-diagram filter symbols and terminology, which are not the compact audio-community response glyph target.
sources.reuse_note: Do not copy IEC artwork without permission.

sources.claim: A software project maps a filter-response icon family to custom font code points, demonstrating a nonportable implementation workaround.
